about: The projections of src/core/textures.ts (projectPoint: projection and axis as the RSB codes, the mapping, the image aspect, a point, its unit normal and the uv the mesh gives there; then up to three (u, v, weight): a box its axes X, Y, Z, the others one) and its labels (labelFrame, then labelCoords: covered, s, t) at sample points, in f64. Pinned by tests/texture-mapping.test.ts; the engine (engine/crates/rt-core/src/texture/tests.rs) must give the same in f32.
